blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(x^2\) aur \(e^{ax}\) ka product hai, aur \(a\) ek constant hai (\(a \ne 0\)).
Find karna hai indefinite integral.
\(x^2\) ko first function banayenge; ek dafa differentiate karne se \(2x\), doosri dafa 2. Is liye parts do dafa lagana parega.
Doosri dafa wala integral \(\int x e^{ax}\,dx\) bilkul kitab ka Example 30 hai, us ka result seedha use karenge.
Plan: parts \(\to\) Example 30 \(\to\) simplify.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int x^2 e^{ax}\,dx\), \(a \ne 0\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: parts: \(f(x) = x^2\), \(g(x) = e^{ax}\); bacha hua \(\int x e^{ax}\,dx\) Example 30 hai.

Pehli dafa parts
\[= x^2\cdot\dfrac{e^{ax}}{a} - \int \dfrac{e^{ax}}{a}\cdot 2x\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{x^2e^{ax}}{a} - \dfrac{2}{a}\int x e^{ax}\,dx\]
Kyun: \(e^{ax}\) ka integral \(\frac{e^{ax}}{a}\) aur \(x^2\) ka derivative \(2x\). Power \(x^2\) se \(x\) par aa gayi, yani integral pehle se aasaan ho gaya.

Example 30 ka result
\[\int x e^{ax}\,dx = \dfrac{xe^{ax}}{a} - \dfrac{e^{ax}}{a^2}\]
Kyun: yeh kitab ka Example 30 hai: \(x\) first aur \(e^{ax}\) second le kar ek aur dafa parts lagane se yahi aata hai. Ise dobara karne ki zaroorat nahi.

Wapas rakh kar khol dein
\[= \dfrac{x^2e^{ax}}{a} - \dfrac{2}{a}\left(\dfrac{xe^{ax}}{a} - \dfrac{e^{ax}}{a^2}\right) + c\]
\[= \dfrac{x^2e^{ax}}{a} - \dfrac{2xe^{ax}}{a^2} + \dfrac{2e^{ax}}{a^3} + c\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{2}{a}\) ko bracket ke dono terms se zarb kiya. Doosra term minus \(\times\) minus se plus ban gaya.
Dhyan dein: bracket ke andar wale minus ko na bhoolein; aakhri term \(+\frac{2e^{ax}}{a^3}\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(\dfrac{x^2e^{ax}}{a}\right) = \dfrac{2xe^{ax}}{a} + x^2e^{ax}\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(\dfrac{2xe^{ax}}{a^2}\right) = \dfrac{2e^{ax}}{a^2} + \dfrac{2xe^{ax}}{a}\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(\dfrac{2e^{ax}}{a^3}\right) = \dfrac{2e^{ax}}{a^2}\]
Kyun: pehla minus doosra plus teesra: \(\frac{2xe^{ax}}{a}\) aur \(\frac{2e^{ax}}{a^2}\) dono cancel ho jate hain aur sirf \(x^2e^{ax}\) bachta hai.
